newsitem.title: UK: May gas oil contract to deliver 97,100 tonnes - IP.
newsitem.headline: May gas oil contract to deliver 97,100 tonnes - IP.

text.p: A total of 97,100 tonnes of gas oil will be delivered into the May IPE gas oil contract, said a source at the exchange on Monday.
Earlier oil dealers had said they expected a much larger volume to be delivered into the contract, possibly between 200,000 and 500,000 tonnes.
The contract expired at 1200 London time on Monday with 971 contracts left open, each representing 100 tonnes of gas oil.
